baseline.name: Extend every subarray and count its target frequency
baseline.approach: For each start position, incrementally count target/non-target values for every end position and test majority.

archived.name: One-step prefix-frequency majority counting
archived.time: O(n), including initialization of O(n) frequency slots
archived.space: O(n) auxiliary frequency array; counters use long long for the total

why: Mapping target to +1 turns majority into a positive subarray sum; prefix sums change by one, so a frequency at one boundary updates the count of valid earlier prefixes.
quantitative_comparison: The baseline examines n(n+1)/2 subarray extensions. The archive performs n prefix transitions plus initialization of 2n+3 frequency slots. This is a candidate/work-structure comparison, not a stopwatch speedup or a universal constant-factor guarantee.
tradeoffs: Uses O(n) frequency storage and wider total counters. Returning zero on allocation failure is ambiguous, and size arithmetic depends on judged bounds.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
